app.name: OneCite
app.one_liner: A command-line tool and Python library that parses mixed academic reference inputs (DOIs, titles, arXiv IDs, etc.) into standardized BibTeX using metadata from multiple scholarly sources.

screens.name: CLI Interface
screens.purpose: Accept raw reference input and output formatted BibTeX via command line.
primary_actions: Output BibTeX to stdout or file

rust_commands.name: parse_references
rust_commands.purpose: Process raw reference strings through the 4-stage pipeline to produce validated BibTeX entries.

mvp_plan: week 1: Implement core 4-stage pipeline (clean → query → validate → format)
week 1: Integrate CrossRef and arXiv metadata lookup
week 1: Support DOI and arXiv ID input parsing
acceptance_tests: Given a malformed title, the system attempts fuzzy matching against Semantic Scholar and reports confidence score.
Given a valid DOI, the system returns correct BibTeX with all available fields including abstract.
